vlmeval.prompt_convention_notes: VLMEvalKit splits prompt construction between dataset classes (default) and per-model use_custom_prompt/build_prompt overrides. For POPE the dataset default is the bare TSV question (no yes/no instruction); whether a model sees a yes/no suffix depends on its adapter (moondream: yes, at moondream.py:186-187; Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct as registered: no, use_custom_prompt=False at config.py:1163; InternVLChat: no, internvl_chat.py:264). For CountBenchQA the dataset-level template at image_vqa.py:2346 applies to all models without a matching custom prompt. Any custom harness aiming for prompt parity should cite image_vqa.py:2339-2348 (CountBenchQA) and image_yorn.py:25-32 + image_base.py:186-203 (POPE), plus the per-adapter overrides for the specific model under test.

vlmeval.flip_recommendation: Do NOT flip VLMEvalKit to primary at the pinned release tag; keep the custom harness as primary and use VLMEvalKit as a secondary cross-check. Rationale at v0.3rc1 (8eb37bb): (1) the study's headline model, LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-450M, has no adapter at all (zero lfm/liquid matches repo-wide) — lfm2_5_vl_supported=false — so the primary instrument would exclude the primary subject; (2) RefCOCO-M/RefCOCO grounding is entirely absent, killing one of three benchmark columns; (3) InternVL3_5-1B has no registry entry (tag predates the model). Coverage at the tag is only POPE+CountBenchQA for 4 of 6 models. A conditional alternative: pin to a recent main commit instead of a release tag (e.g., origin/main 0bfa830fa42fd1d5ac485bbb0bbc78e16c079e18, 2026-06-29), which adds the LFM2VL adapter, an InternVL3_5-1B entry, and a RefCOCO GROUNDING dataset — but even there our exact LFM2.5-VL-450M checkpoint has no registry alias (needs a one-line addition or model_path override), RefCOCO is upstream's unified TSV rather than 'RefCOCO-M', and pinning to an untagged main commit sacrifices release-level reproducibility. Recommended posture: custom harness primary for all six models; run VLMEvalKit at v0.3rc1 on POPE+CountBenchQA for the four fully covered models as an external validity check; adopt/cite VLMEvalKit's prompt templates (image_vqa.py:2339-2348 for CountBenchQA; image_yorn.py:25-32 + image_base.py:186-203 for POPE) in the custom harness to keep numbers comparable; revisit the flip decision if/when upstream tags a release containing liquid.py + refcoco.py.

md05b.sampler_controls: The .mf runtime (moondream 0.0.6) exposes exactly ONE decoding knob: settings={'max_tokens': int} (SamplingSettings = TypedDict({'max_tokens': int}, total=False); DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 512), accepted only by caption() and query(). Decoding is hard-coded GREEDY argmax (next_token = np.argmax(logits) in _generate; detect/point likewise argmax over coord/size heads). There is NO temperature, NO top_p/top_k, NO sampling on/off toggle, and detect/point accept no settings at all. Source: moondream-0.0.6 moondream/types.py (SamplingSettings) and moondream/onnx_vl.py (_generate, DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS). Contrast: the current cloud/Photon client (moondream 1.3.0 types.py) adds temperature and top_p to SamplingSettings, but its local Photon path forwards only max_tokens (_build_settings in photon_vl.py) and cannot run the 0.5B anyway.
md05b.image_token_or_resolution_control: NONE. The .mf runtime exposes no image-token, crop-count, or resolution parameter anywhere in its public API: encode_image(image) takes only the image; caption/query/detect/point take no image-processing arguments. Internally (moondream-0.0.6 moondream/preprocess.py, create_patches(image, image_patch_size=378)): images are always processed as fixed 378x378 patches — one global patch plus, if max(width,height) >= 378*1.4 (~529 px), 2-4 crops chosen automatically by aspect ratio from hard-coded templates [(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)] then adaptive-avg-pooled back to one grid; smaller images use the single global patch with duplicated features. image_patch_size is a function default never surfaced to users. The ONLY way to influence vision compute/tokens is to pre-resize the input image below/above the ~529 px threshold to flip the automatic 1-patch vs multi-crop template selection — an indirect, undocumented mechanism, not a parameter. For the sweep: treat image-token count as NOT controllable in this runtime.

### Proposed sweep points (per-image visual tokens)
- **LFM2.5-VL-450M** (`do_image_splitting=False`, set `min_image_tokens=max_image_tokens=T` to pin): T = **256 (default cap / max)**, 128 (mid), 64 (low, = shipped min default), 32 (floor, = model-card recommended min). Default full-pipeline point = max 256 + splitting True.

| Target tokens | LFM (max_image_tokens, split off) | SmolVLM2 (longest_edge) | Moondream 0.5B |
|---|---|---|---|
| ~64 | 64 | 512 (=64) | — |
| ~256-320 | 256 (default cap) | 1024 (<=320) | — |
